verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships its skills as plain markdown folders in `skills/`, shared verbatim with every harness. A hands-on probe confirmed a selective install copied a skill into `./.claude/skills/` as readable files, with a warning to review skills before use, so reading what was installed afterward is supported. Listing contents before install is not a documented Superpowers feature: the probe used the separate `npx skills` installer, and community notes say the Codex and OpenCode installs are agent-driven fetch-and-follow flows that are harder to audit in advance. missing for 10: a first-party pre-install listing or preview of skill files and scripts, documentation of where installed files land and how to audit them across all harnesses, and independent corroboration beyond one probe.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can review exactly what instructions and scripts a skill will add — list contents before installing and read every file afterward

citations.quote: Skills are plain, selectively-installable markdown folders.
